verdict: CONDITIONAL on the declared common-strain model, whose claimed closure is WITHDRAWN: the priced theta webs do not balance under that kinematics (see equilibriumDeficit — the sole first review demonstrated the deficit and this unit reproduces it). Within the model, the pressure resultant is TRACED film -> barrel rings + inner rail (the retained replacement section ALONE, 1 453.5 mm2 — the v1.2.x 2 507 mm2 double-credit is a labelled failed calculation) -> caps/longerons, and the cords' static duty is their own pretension. The binding model result is kinematic: while taut, dT/T0 = kappa*eps_box / (eps0*(1+beta*kappa)), then slack-clamped; at the barrel eps_box 5.95e-3 exceeds the declared eps0 2.0e-3 by 2.98x, so cords tensioned before pump-down go slack over the barrel (65/69 d60 and 62/68 d11 planes, ~94%) — against a foundation-loss tolerance of 0.081% rigid licensed (the QUOTABLE bound, from the record), while the drawn-termination compliant state computes 0.087% — BEYOND the rigid anchor on the v3 consistent spring law (eta > 1), reported and NOT claimed — which un-licenses the stability PASS within the model. The record's margins are valid only for an assembly that sets (or maintains) the stud length at the pumped-down state — and resetting through the EXISTING studs is UNAVAILABLE: the longest representative cord needs ~0.58 m combined take-up at the model's own barrel strain against 0.254 m of combined stud LENGTH before thread engagement (resetTravel). Any install-after-evacuation or added-travel construction is UNQUALIFIED with UNKNOWN parts and mass. The deeper-eps0 alternative is quantified as a DEMAND comparison only (restrained set load 1.56x/1.62x the priced fitting demand — a demand, not a capacity; stud capacity UNKNOWN) and left UNPRICED. The retained construction's compatibility/force balance, full-hull closure, the bolted station connection's laminate capacities and the cord strength remain UNKNOWN.
